job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled GenAI Engineer to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and cloud-native development, with the ability to deliver secure and scalable AI-powered applications

Key Responsibilities Design and develop Generative AI solutions using AWS services (Lambda, Bedrock, MWAA, S3, DynamoDB) Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures Work with LLMs and enterprise chat platforms (OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, Ollama) Develop and maintain GenAI backend services and MCP servers Design and deploy containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes Integrate vector databases (Weaviate or similar) for semantic search Ensure scalability, security, and observability of AI systems Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align AI solutions with business needs Contribute to architecture decisions and technical strategy Required Skills Strong experience with AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, MWAA, S3, DynamoDB) Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG, NLP, and text processing pipelines

Hands-on with OpenAI APIs, ChatGPT, Anthropic (Claude), Ollama Experience in microservices architecture, Docker, Kubernetes Knowledge of vector databases (Weaviate or similar) Strong programming skills in TypeScript / JavaScript Experience in building enterprise AI platforms / middleware Knowledge of Chrome Extension development Good to Have Experience with API gateways, authentication & authorization Exposure to CI/CD and MLOps for AI systems Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools Experience in enterprise-scale system design Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking Ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders Proactive mindset with strong ownership and accountability Skills (1 Line) GenAI, LLM, RAG, AWS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Docker, Kubernetes, Vector DB
